title: calamaria bolanderi
intro: Calamaria bolanderi, commonly known as Bolander's calamaria, is a species of flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting antioxidant activity, thereby supporting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Bolander's calamaria include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential candidate for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
